result.summary: Revenue rose by 17,451.01 (1.02%), from 1,715,741.22 in 2026-07 to 1,733,192.23 in 2026-08. The change is concentrated in region=Quebec (141%, lift 5.09x). Within region=Quebec, product_category=Apparel holds 45% of that scope's change. For region=Quebec the largest effect is volume (24,077.69). The USD/CAD exchange rate averaged 1.3311 in the base month and 1.3289 in the compare month (-0.17%). That is too small to explain the change. No concentrated driver was found by channel, product.

claims.statement: region=Quebec rose by 24,540.02, which is 141% of the total change (lift 5.09x: it moved faster than its size predicts). Mechanism: volume effect 24,077.69 (positive), price effect 462.33 (positive) (unit cost changed 0.9%; average price changed 0.09%; units changed 5.08%).

product_category=Apparel within region=Quebec rose by 10,959.74, which is 63% of the total change and 45% of its scope (lift 1.59x: it moved faster than its size predicts). Mechanism: volume effect 10,652.19 (positive), price effect 307.55 (positive) (unit cost changed 0.58%; average price changed 0.21%; units changed 8.0%).

ruled_out.why: proportional: 'Retail' holds 42% of the change but its size alone predicts that (lift 1.22)
diffuse: largest same-direction member 'Air Purifier' holds 37% of the scope change

caveats: The decomposition shows which segments moved and by how much; it cannot identify business causes (pricing, campaigns, supply) that are not in the data.
